test_command: cmake --build build --config Debug --target test_exe > $null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit 1 }; Set-Location build/bin/Debug; ./test_exe.exe --gtest_filter=ScriptedInputTest.*:PlayerConfusionTest.*

mutations.catches: a frame with no key running the game update, so the world moves without the player
a typed character never reaching the update
an arrow or keypad move never reaching the update
a frame where key_listen does not run, a menu holding input or a zoom key, vetoing the update; only the game loop reaches it (issue 0151), so expected to survive
the gate inverted, running the update on idle frames; no test runs the game loop (issue 0151), so expected to survive
